title: Burning Dollars: A Protest Against the Destruction of People's Livelihoods
text:
Burning Dollars: A Protest Against the Destruction of People's Livelihoods"

"Hamid Reza Masoudi, Director of Macroeconomic Affairs at the Planning and Budget Organization during the late President Raisi's administration, stated during nighttime gatherings while burning dollars:"
"🔹"We will remove this impure currency from our hearts.""
"🔹"This physically impure thing that burns the livelihood of everyone day by day.""
"🔹"Death to the American dollar!""
"💡💡 @Khabar_Fouri
